finding: Meaningful regression tests compare independent original floating URDF compilation against constructed fixed/actuated scenes and exercise nonzero-wrist placement at zero time. Tests forbid stepping/execution paths. No blocker in existing coverage, recommended extensions needed for conversion failure modes below.

recommendations.detail: Explicitly forbid mj_saveLastXML and interleave compilation of an unrelated model between live specification preparation and actuation. Verify hand+object remain identical,24servos exist,unrelatedbody absent. Hook new live API directly; patching unused old loader would be vacuous.

Use all exact lower and upper bounds from pinned source model. Assign legal endpoint vectors to runner qpos and use existing force_close_targets with delta0; require unchanged outputs under runner limits. Assert exact servo ctrlrange identity with source bounds.

Add mesh vertex count,face count,face indices and object-local mesh vertices. Current object test compares body/geom frames but not mesh vertices/scale. Include nonidentity mesh scale/refpos/refquat and high-precision body/inertial geometry fixture where feasible.
Compare object geom_contype/conaffinity/group and collision-versus-visual identity; preservation of those roles matters alongside shape dimensions.
Static gains,force limits,weld andsolver options establish compiled settings preservation only. No dynamics,outcome or controlperformance claim follows.

other_notes: Root-palm test currently writes wrist indices0/1; name-based WRJ assignments would make purpose explicit.
Exact array equality for unchanged hand fields is appropriate because recompilation of same untouched source should be deterministic under pinned runtime.
All current tests are static. Do not execute unrelated legacy tests whose bodies advance simulation.
